title: Burgerize
subtitle: Full Brand Identity & Web Design
overview: A complete brand identity and web design project for a local burger restaurant, including logo design, packaging, signage, and a fully functional website with online ordering system.
challenge: Create a memorable brand identity that captures the essence of a premium burger experience while developing a user-friendly website that drives online orders and customer engagement.
solution: Developed a bold, modern brand identity with a custom logo, comprehensive visual system, and a responsive website featuring an intuitive ordering system and mouth-watering food photography.

sections.title: Brand Identity
sections.content: The Burgerize brand identity centers around bold, appetizing visuals that immediately communicate quality and taste. The logo features a custom wordmark with a subtle burger icon integration, while the color palette uses warm, food-inspired tones that evoke hunger and satisfaction.

sections.caption: Custom logo design featuring bold typography and burger icon integration

sections.title: Visual System
sections.content: The visual system includes a comprehensive set of guidelines covering logo usage, color applications, typography, and photography style. This ensures consistent brand representation across all touchpoints.

sections.title: Web Design & Development
sections.content: The website was designed with a mobile-first approach, featuring high-quality food photography, an intuitive navigation system, and a streamlined online ordering process. The design emphasizes the visual appeal of the food while maintaining excellent usability.

sections.caption: Homepage design showcasing the full brand experience

sections.title: Photography
sections.content: Professional food photography was essential to showcase the quality and appeal of the menu items. Each dish was carefully styled and photographed to maximize visual impact and drive customer engagement.

testimonial.quote: The new brand identity and website have completely transformed our business. We're seeing more customers than ever before, and the online ordering system has been a game-changer.
testimonial.author: Sarah Johnson
